TI.P:
Information relating to the entry into force of the Agreement between the European Community and the Swiss Confederation amending the Agreement between the European Economic Community and the Swiss Confederation of 22 July 1972 as regards the provisions applicable to processed agricultural products
OJ L 23, 26.1.2005, p. 19.

ENACTING.TERMS.P: The procedures necessary for the entry into force of the Agreement between the European Community and the Swiss Confederation amending the Agreement between the European Economic Community and the Swiss Confederation of 22 July 1972 as regards the provisions applicable to processed agricultural products, signed in Luxembourg on 26 October 2004, having been completed on 29 March 2005, this Agreement entered into force, in conformity with its Article 5(1), on 30 March 2005.
